name: stm32f411
description: ST STM32F411xE (Cortex-M4F 100 MHz, 512 KB flash, 128 KB SRAM, USB OTG FS, 5 SPI, 3 I2C, USART1/2/6, ADC1, 2 DMA with CHSEL routing): GNU Arm toolchain with the STM32CubeF4 HAL/LL, Renode stm32f411 platform

toolchain.notes: Link with a STM32F411RETx_FLASH.ld and startup_stm32f411xe.s from a Cube example (Projects/STM32F411RE-Nucleo/Templates). Whole Cube examples build with tools/stm32cube/build_example.py in the Renode tree; CubeIDE board projects build with `embeddyn mechatronics import`.

image.notes: load the ELF; the vector table is at 0x08000000

renode.notes: Boards: platforms/boards/st/nucleo_f411re.repl (LD2 PA5 = led2, B1 PC13 = sysbus.gpioPortC.userButton, active low, VCP usart2). The RCC clock tree (HSI/HSE/PLL, HPRE, PPRE1/PPRE2) drives SysTick and the timers; CIR ready interrupts. DMA requests (SPI, USART1/2/6, ADC1, TIM1-5 update) reach the stream whose CHSEL selects them (dmaRouter). ADC1 (F4 layout): 'adc1 SetVoltage microvolts channel', temperature on 16/18, VREFINT 17, TIM1-5 TRGO triggers. USB OTG FS device: attach USB.USBSerialHost ('usbSerial Attach sysbus.usbOtgFs'). Pins: add 'pins: Miscellaneous.PinRecorder @ gpioPortA 0' and connections such as 'gpioPortA:' / '    5 -> led2@0 | pins@5' (a .repl file), then 'sysbus.gpioPortA.pins Edges 5'. Docs: tools/stm32cube/README.md.

reference.simulator: none; the models are checked with the STM32CubeF4 examples (tools/stm32cube/run_examples.py with examples_f411.txt in the Renode tree)
